what_the_files_show: Checked against the three tests in the procedure. RI-FMW-001: Croatia (the only applied removal), Montenegro (removal dated to accession, benchmark closed June 2026), Serbia (stalled, closest wording). RI-TEC-028: Moldova (closest mechanism, with an audit), Serbia (wider connection, yet about 53% of citizens still resubmit documents), Montenegro (closest EU wording, stalled). RI-TEC-036: Moldova (same low demand, use measured per service), Albania (high use, thin depth, possibly because use is mandatory), Montenegro (stalled, same starting point).
agent_recommendation: Approve all. Reserves: Moldova for RI-FMW-001, Albania for RI-TEC-028, Serbia for RI-TEC-036. Montenegro and Moldova recur, which limits the sources needed.
what_changes: This sets what the policy options can draw on. Each issue deliberately includes a stalled or mixed case, so lessons are not drawn only from apparent successes.

decision_needed: Allow pre-2020 evidence for Croatia and for Serbia's screening report?
what_the_files_show: Croatia acceded in 2013, so its Chapter 2 reform can only be read in documents from 2007 to 2015. The run limits evidence to 2020 onwards unless an exception is logged.
agent_recommendation: Log a narrow exception for these comparator documents on RI-FMW-001 only.
what_changes: Without it, RI-FMW-001 has no case where removal has actually been applied, which is the most useful one for North Macedonia.

decision_needed: Use the EU common position on Montenegro marked LIMITE?
what_the_files_show: The document on Chapter 2 is on the Council register but carries a restricted marking. It is the best statement of what closed the benchmark.
agent_recommendation: Do not use it. Rely on Commission reports and public statements, and record the gap.
what_changes: Using it may give sharper evidence on Montenegro, but would put a restricted document in a public repository.

decision_needed: Proceed knowing that outcome evidence is thin?
what_the_files_show: For RI-FMW-001, outcomes are mostly legal, with no independent source on practical effect. For RI-TEC-028, no audit found shows what raised use, so attribution will be weak. For RI-TEC-036, no like-for-like transaction data exists, and the common use indicator counts any online contact. Moldova's audit page and the SIGMA 2024 reports were blocked (HTTP 403).
agent_recommendation: Proceed, and report lessons as conditional. Do not widen to more countries or a further source search. You may drop the blocked documents into sources/_inbox if you want them, but the pilot can run without them.
what_changes: Sets expectations: the pilot will show what was tried and what resulted, with limited proof of what caused it.

decision_needed: Approve the source list and proposed lessons log entries?
what_the_files_show: 38 comparator source lines after removing duplicates (role comparator), about 4 to 6 per country and issue. No source requirement for full country reports beyond these.
what_changes: Acquisition starts on these lines only.
